# Basic information about the observations

Filament in the NOAA 12159 active region was observed on 11 Sept 2014 9:28 - 10:04 UT at VTT at Tenerife with Eche- Ile spectrograph together with TIP1 spectropolarimeter in

IR and simultaneously in Ho by the TESOS Farbry-Pérot interferometer:

- position of the filament: 215 arcsec, -420 arcsec; 3 scans made with spectrograph between 9:28 - 10:04 UT
- spectropolarimetric observations in chromospheric Hel

IR triplet with wavelength around 10830Å, photospheric line Sil 10827Å; height of the slit approx. 30ạẠỊạ 1 pxl along the slit 0.35'', scan step of 0.45'', scanned approx. 10'

- spectroscopic observations in Call 8542Å
- 2D observations with the TESOS Fabry-Pérot interfero-meter, FOV of 25x25i, step 0.025 Å of scanning in 2 within interval 6561.2 - 6564.5 Å
- the 3rd scan was used, and TESOS observation No.33
